title: Warrant request body
description: The inspectorate asks a Court for a warrant (register row DK1744; spec-delta S1605; docs/institutions/inspectorate.md 3): `subject` and its `sponsor`, the classes of `data` it asks to open (never key_material: warrant_request_key_material), the `grounds` and the `scope` in words. Signed by the inspectorate (warrant_request_wrong_issuer); the subject must have a passport (warrant_request_unknown_agent). A Court answers with a `warrant` that cites this request (`request`): the same subject, no class the request did not ask for, once for each request. The request opens nothing by itself. Chain: none (prev is null).
